title: Импорт — Loginom Data файл
semantics: Read one admitted standalone LGD into output table 0, retaining field names, labels, scalar types, data kinds, field/row order and NULL versus empty string. parameters.source identifies the completed delivery; lgd_import.checksum=verify. No training. Corruption refuses; never disable checksums. Done saves settings without execution; Close discards the draft. DDF, Variant, variables and non-default compression are outside this slice.

parameter_schema.description: New import requires source and checksum. Existing {} preserves saved source/settings.

source.description: Completed admitted LGD attachment; reuse existing artifact delivery contract.

artifact_id.description: Artifact ID returned by completed delivery.

upload_operation_id.description: Operation ID of that same completed delivery.

lgd_import.description: LGD read settings; unsupported modes refuse before mutation.

checksum.description: Always verify stored checksums; never retry damaged LGD with checks disabled.
